{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kallea Tour''' was the name given to the [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]-long tour of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' that toured the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], including [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]]. The tour was sponsored by [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV's]] [[Council of Human High Culture]] and two commerce houses, [[House Brentioch]] and [[Hall Jo'uda]].
